test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following ministries launched the Aadhaar Good Governance Portal to streamline approval process for Aadhaar authentication requests and to make Aadhaar more people-friendly, enable ease of living, and enable better access to services for people?

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)** launched the **Aadhaar Good Governance Portal** to simplify and streamline the process for various government entities seeking permission for **Aadhaar authentication**.
 
• The portal is designed to provide a **single-window interface** for government **Departments and Ministries**, allowing them to submit and track their applications for utilizing Aadhaar services in their respective governance frameworks.
